# Blueprint schema

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-blueprint-doc.mjs from packages/shared/src. Do not edit by hand; CI fails on drift. -->

The types every House of Rama package shares. The Blueprint is written only by `packages/blueprint` from a git checkout (Invariant 1).

## Layer

A floor of the building. The house-stack defaults are listed; a target may define its own in `.rama/layers.json`.

Source: `packages/shared/src/blueprint.ts`

```ts
type Layer = 'foundation' | 'data' | 'logic' | 'api' | 'interface' | 'shell' | string;
```

## BrickNode

One tracked file of the target repository, drawn as a brick.

Source: `packages/shared/src/blueprint.ts`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | Path relative to the repository root, forward slashes. |
| `layer` | `Layer` | yes | The floor this brick sits on. |
| `layerRule` | `string` | yes | The rule that assigned the layer: an overlay rule from `.rama/layers.json` or a house-stack default. |
| `lines` | `number` | yes | Text lines in the file; 0 for binary files. |
| `bytes` | `number` | yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `binary` | `boolean` | yes | True when the file is not text. |
| `test` | `boolean` | yes | True when the file is a test file. |
| `exports` | `string[]` | yes | Names the file exports. |
| `env` | `string[]` | yes | Environment variable names the file reads. |
| `envDynamic` | `boolean` | yes | True when the file also reads an environment variable whose name the extractor could not resolve. |
| `firstCommit` | `string` | yes | SHA of the oldest commit in the extracted history that touched the file; empty when none did (a pending file). |
| `lastCommit` | `string` | yes | SHA of the most recent commit in the extracted history that touched the file; empty when none did. |
| `changes` | `number` | yes | Number of commits that changed the file. |
| `purpose` | `{ text: string; confirmed: boolean; by?: string; at?: string }` | no | What the brick is for, in English: from the `.rama/` overlay when confirmed, otherwise an unconfirmed draft. |

## ImportEdge

A resolved internal import from one brick to another.

Source: `packages/shared/src/blueprint.ts`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | `string` | yes | Path of the importing brick. |
| `to` | `string` | yes | Path of the imported brick. |
| `symbols` | `string[]` | yes | Symbols imported across the edge: names, `default`, or `*` for a namespace, re-export-all or dynamic import; empty for a side-effect import. |
| `typeOnly` | `boolean` | yes | True when every import across the edge is type-only, so it carries no runtime dependency. |
| `english` | `{ text: string; confirmed: boolean; by?: string; at?: string }` | no | The dependency in English, from `.rama/glossary.json`; unconfirmed until a named person confirms it. |

## Commit

One commit of the target's history.

Source: `packages/shared/src/blueprint.ts`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sha` | `string` | yes | Full commit SHA. |
| `short` | `string` | yes | Abbreviated SHA as git prints it. |
| `at` | `string` | yes | Commit timestamp, ISO 8601. |
| `author` | `string` | yes | Author name. |
| `subject` | `string` | yes | First line of the commit message. |
| `changes` | `{ path: string; kind: 'A' \| 'M' \| 'D' \| 'R'; add: number \| null; del: number \| null; from?: string; }[]` | yes | Per-file changes: kind (Added, Modified, Deleted, Renamed), line counts (null for binary files), and the old path of a rename. |

## Screen

A screen of the target's app: a route and the bricks that render it.

Source: `packages/shared/src/blueprint.ts`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Stable screen identifier. |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Human name of the screen. |
| `route` | `string` | yes | Route path pattern, e.g. `/bills/[id]`. |
| `file` | `string` | yes | The file that defines the route. |
| `bricks` | `string[]` | yes | Paths of the bricks that render the screen (the route's import closure). |
| `shot` | `string` | no | Path to the captured screenshot, when one exists. |
| `figures` | `FigureRef[]` | no | Figures found on the captured screen. |

## FigureRef

A figure located on a captured screen.

Source: `packages/shared/src/blueprint.ts`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Figure identifier (`data-rama-figure`). |
| `box` | `{ x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }` | yes | Bounding box on the screenshot, in pixels. |
| `traced` | `boolean` | yes | True when a trail exists for the figure; false renders it in the untraced state. |
| `text` | `string` | no | The figure's text as the screen showed it, when it was read from the page. |

## Blueprint

The generated, machine-maintained model of a repository at one commit.

Source: `packages/shared/src/blueprint.ts`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `repo` | `string` | yes | Repository identifier (URL or path) the Blueprint was extracted from. |
| `commit` | `string` | yes | SHA of the commit extracted; with `worktree`, the commit the working tree sits on. Empty when there is no history. |
| `worktree` | `boolean` | yes | True when files were read from a working tree with changes pending on top of `commit` (how this repository renders itself). |
| `extractedAt` | `string` | yes | Committer date of `commit`, ISO 8601: deterministic, so re-extracting the same commit is byte-identical. |
| `extractorVersion` | `string` | yes | Version of the extractor that wrote the Blueprint. |
| `layers` | `{ id: Layer; label: string }[]` | yes | The floors, bottom to top. |
| `nodes` | `BrickNode[]` | yes | One brick per tracked file. |
| `edges` | `ImportEdge[]` | yes | Resolved internal imports. |
| `unresolved` | `{ from: string; spec: string }[]` | yes | Relative or aliased imports that point inside the repository but match no tracked file. |
| `external` | `{ name: string; version: string; dev: boolean; manifest: string }[]` | yes | External dependencies with their declared versions, the manifest declaring them, and whether they are dev-only. |
| `commits` | `Commit[]` | yes | Full history, oldest first. |
| `branches` | `string[]` | yes | Branch names (local and remote, deduplicated); empty in a worktree extraction, where refs depend on the machine. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | yes | Tag names; empty in a worktree extraction. |
| `screens` | `Screen[]` | yes | Screens discovered from the app's routes. |

## Trail

The path from a figure on a screen back to its formula, inputs, data, build history and signature.

Source: `packages/shared/src/trail.ts`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `figureId` | `string` | yes | The figure this trail explains. |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Short title of the figure. |
| `what` | `string` | yes | What the figure means, in one sentence. |
| `formula` | `{ english: string; code: string; file: string; line: number }` | yes | The formula in English and in code, with its location. |
| `inputs` | `{ label: string; value: string \| null; source: string }[]` | yes | Inputs to the formula; value is null when it could not be re-executed rather than retyped. |
| `data` | `string[]` | yes | Where each input lives: table and column, file constant or browser storage. |
| `build` | `{ sha: string; at: string; author: string; subject: string; file: string }[]` | yes | Commits that touched the trail's files. |
| `signoff` | `Signoff \| null` | yes | The signature on the figure's screen, or null when unsigned. |
| `reexecuted` | `boolean` | yes | True when the values come from re-executing the target's own function. |
| `result` | `{ shown: string \| null; computed: string \| null; matches: boolean \| null }` | no | The figure as the screen showed it, as re-execution computed it, and whether the two agree (null when either is missing). |
| `reexecutionError` | `string` | no | Why the trail has no re-executed values, when it has none. |

## Decision

A decision card from a discovery session.

Source: `packages/shared/src/ceremony.ts`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Decision identifier. |
| `siteId` | `string` | yes | The site the decision belongs to. |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Short title. |
| `statement` | `string` | yes | The decision as stated and confirmed. |
| `bricks` | `string[]` | yes | Paths of the bricks the decision concerns. |
| `screenId` | `string` | no | The screen the decision concerns, when there is one. |
| `status` | `'decided' \| 'open' \| 'not-built'` | yes | Whether the decision is made, still open, or made but not built. |
| `by` | `string` | yes | The person who recorded the decision. |
| `at` | `string` | yes | When the decision was recorded, ISO 8601. |
| `reconstructed` | `boolean` | no | True when the record was reconstructed after the fact rather than captured live. |

## Signoff

A named signature on a screen or brick at a commit. Append-only: a reversal is a new Signoff that supersedes the old one.

Source: `packages/shared/src/ceremony.ts`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Signoff identifier. |
| `siteId` | `string` | yes | The site the signature belongs to. |
| `person` | `string` | yes | The person who signed. |
| `target` | `{ kind: 'screen' \| 'brick'; id: string; commit: string }` | yes | What was signed: a screen or brick, at a commit. |
| `statement` | `string` | yes | The statement the person signed. |
| `at` | `string` | yes | When it was signed, ISO 8601. |
| `supersedes` | `string` | no | The Signoff this one reverses or replaces, when any. |

## Finding

One verdict from an audit on one brick.

Source: `packages/shared/src/audit.ts`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Finding identifier. |
| `auditId` | `string` | yes | The audit that produced the finding. |
| `brick` | `string` | yes | Path of the brick the finding concerns. |
| `check` | `string` | yes | The check that produced the finding (MASTER-PROMPT §7.3). |
| `verdict` | `'pass' \| 'note' \| 'defect'` | yes | Pass, a note, or a defect. |
| `text` | `string` | yes | The finding in words. |
| `file` | `string` | no | File the finding points at, when any. |
| `line` | `number` | no | Line the finding points at, when any. |
